rules.semantic: A slime character's level after a high-experience split is the highest level whose cumulative experience requirement (sum over k=2..L of 8000+2000(k-1)+4000(k-2), uint32) does not exceed the experience held; level 1 below 8000.

tests.note: exp 60000 -> exp/2 30000 -> EXPECT_EQ level 3 on both halves: the level-3 arm only

rules.semantic: A big slime bot only SPLITs while the world's head-count is under MAXOBS (room for the extra body); small and medium slimes have no AI gate (GROW is always rolled).

tests.note: ASSERT_TRUE(check_special()) far below MAXOBS: true arm

rules.semantic: When a NAMED slime dies and splits, the dying slime takes the offspring's freshly drawn name (sic, classic direction); an unnamed slime keeps no name.

arms.observable: parent's stats name == child's name (child keeps its own random name)

tests.note: named parent BLOBBY: EXPECT_EQ child name == parent name

rules.semantic: A dying slime that carries a player character hands the character to its offspring (the roster entry survives the split).
A big slime fissions only when its SPLIT animation completes; any other animation wrap is ignored.

arms.observable: hook returns false, no SMALL_SLIME created
parent becomes SMALL_SLIME shifted (-10,+10), a second SMALL_SLIME at parent+(12,-12), both same team/foe/leader, ani_type ANI_WALK

rules.condition: if child:has_guy() and child:g_exp() < exp_needed ... elseif child:has_guy()
rules.semantic: A hired slime that splits can only sustain a second character if it holds at least 1000 x level experience: below that the sibling is stripped to a plain monster named SLIME at level calculate_level(exp/2); at or above it both halves keep a character, each levelled to calculate_level(exp/2) holding exp/2.

arms.observable: neither arm: sibling just copies stats
sibling myguy == nullptr, name 'SLIME', parent keeps its character
both myguy exp == exp/2, both myguy level == calculate_level(exp/2)

tests.note: sibling myguy nullptr, name SLIME, parent keeps myguy

rules.semantic: A small or medium slime GROWs into the next size only when all eight neighbouring probe boxes are free; otherwise the cast fails with NO ROOM TO GROW and the slime wanders 10 steps in a random direction (two og.rand(3) draws, y first).

arms.observable: family becomes MEDIUM (from small) or SLIME (from medium); cast true
family unchanged, cast false 'NO ROOM TO GROW', COMMAND_WALK 10 queued, walker ends on a moved tile

tests.fact: WalkerFamilyCount(FAMILY_SMALL_SLIME,1,1)+WalkerFamilyCount(FAMILY_MEDIUM_SLIME,0,0)+WalkerPositionMoved(FAMILY_SMALL_SLIME,102,102) (blocked arm: family unchanged, the 10-step walk landing tile)

other.note: add_ob failure (object cap) on death split: the dying slime simply dies with no offspring; null guard.
add_ob failure on split: parent already transformed into a small slime, no sibling; object-cap guard.
exp_needed = 1000*level is negative only for level < 0, unreachable (level >= 1 engine invariant); uint32-cast mirror.
